title: The Code on Wages, 2019 (No. 29 of 2019)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Consolidates the Payment of Wages Act 1936, the Minimum Wages Act 1948, the Payment of Bonus Act 1965 and the Equal Remuneration Act 1976.

title: The Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 (No. 21 of 1965)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Minimum bonus 8.33 per cent, maximum twenty per cent, thirty working days to qualify.

title: The Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 (No. 39 of 1972)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Gratuity after five years of continuous service, at fifteen days' wages per completed year.

title: The Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (No. 53 of 1961) - principal Act
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: The principal Act as published by the ministry: twelve weeks. The 2017 amendment below substitutes twenty-six.

title: The Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 (No. 6 of 2017) - Gazette of India
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Substitutes twenty-six weeks, adds the creche duty at fifty or more employees and work from home.

title: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (No. 14 of 2013) - Gazette scan
publisher: Gujarat Informatics Ltd, Government of Gujarat (Gazette of India reprint)
note: A SCANNED Gazette: JBIG2 images, no text layer. pypdf returns noise; this is the document only the Document AI OCR lane can read (lesson 4.1).

title: The Code on Social Security, 2020 (No. 36 of 2020)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Consolidates nine social-security laws, the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 and the Maternity Benefit Act 1961 among them: gratuity for a fixed term employee on pro rata basis (s. 53), gig and platform workers defined.

title: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (No. 35 of 2020)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Trade unions, standing orders (three hundred or more workers), grievance redressal, fixed term employment, strikes and lay-offs.

title: The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (No. 37 of 2020)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: Working hours, overtime at twice the rate of wages (s. 27), one day of leave for every twenty days worked (s. 32), safety duties and welfare.

title: Compliance Handbook for Employers Under the Four Labour Codes (Central Government Sphere)
publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
note: The ministry's own employer guide to the four Codes - registrations, returns, gratuity for fixed term employees after one year - the kind of document an HR team keeps beside the Acts.

title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023)
publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
note: Data Fiduciary, Data Principal, Consent Manager, the Data Protection Board of India - what an AI-tool policy and a vendor contract must comply with.

title: The Information Technology Act, 2000 (No. 21 of 2000) - as enacted
publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
note: The 2000 text as MeitY publishes it (before the 2008 amendment): digital signatures, electronic records, intermediaries, the Cyber Appellate Tribunal.

title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (No. 12 of 2017) - as on 1 August 2021
publisher: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs, Government of India
note: 236 pages: the law behind every invoice in the corpus - tax invoice, time of supply, input tax credit, the twenty per cent ceiling on the rate of central tax.
